name: Unwanted and Unworthy

narrative.details:
The Al'aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds in-between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.

<Elegael spits.>

These storm cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.
narrative.objectives: Collect 10 Bloodied Heirlooms from Al'Aketh Footsoldiers and Al'Aketh Stormchasers in the Shadowgale Forest.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Elegael looks down at the collection of bloodied heirlooms with distress.>So many young lives with so much potential now gone forever. Thank you for returning these, champion.I will hold onto them for safe keeping until I am able to take them to the High Elder. There they can go back into the collection and await the next and perhaps more worthy generation to come of age.
narrative.requestItemsText: I will make the cult pay for every drop of druid blood they have spilled this day.

mentionedItems.name: Bloody Heirloom
tooltip: "Drenched in the blood of those who were once promised a brighter future."
